rationale_one_line: Strix ships in its own dark security-console palette (near-black slate, one hot alert red, JetBrains Mono like a terminal) because recognition is the quote-post trigger for an appsec builder; MANIFESTO carries the contrarian proof-over-guesses thesis and breaks yesterday's RECEIPT streak.
writing_tone_notes: Adversarial but unhyped, plain declarative, subtraction over adjectives. Let the contrast carry the praise: scanners flag maybes, this one exploits to prove. Exact technical claims, zero superlatives. Contractions where natural.
do_rules: Lead with the proof-by-exploit angle, the one thing scanners don't do.
Use the alert red as a single highlight per beat, on the finding and the punch, never decoratively.
Keep the contrast doing the work: a maybe versus a working exploit, guesses versus a fix.
dont_rules: No version numbers in the caption.
No superlatives or sycophancy, and no attack framing aimed at any real target.
Do not repeat any scene phrase in the tweet or the Gmail Why-this-one.
